blockingIssues.description: Runner event/state constants are required to be string-literal typed, but literals are erased by utils.defineConstants typing (returns Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>), leading to downstream casts like `as string` instead of enforced literal unions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit guidance that `utils.defineConstants` currently erases literal types; when a feature requires string-literal event constants, workers should either preserve literal typing via typed constant objects / helper overloads or update utility typing accordingly.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: core-runner review failed on this exact mismatch; lib/utils.ts defines `defineConstants(obj: Record<string, unknown>): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>` and lib/runner.ts uses `as string` casts.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a migration pitfall note about TDZ regressions when replacing `var` with `let/const` in callback result capture patterns.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: core-domain handoff skill feedback explicitly called out TDZ hazards encountered during migration.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Validate dependency-order statements in feature descriptions against actual import graph before assigning migration order.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: core-foundations feature description stated an incorrect dependency order (errors before utils), while implementation evidence documented the opposite import dependency.
